x-capture-oc-table-columns.name: science

x-capture-oc-table-columns.name: gate_power

x-capture-oc-table-columns.description: The product's cadence coherence time on the class, in-band: measured, bound, constant, refused: <reason> or another status of the estimator (verbatim).

x-capture-oc-table-columns.name: G_zero

x-capture-oc-table-columns.name: gamma_n

x-row-rules.kept: event 'kept' aggregates the policy's kept science dumps; A, A_net, measured and x_power are filled only when a kept dump has a reading and the control level exists
x-row-rules.polmax: cadence readings only: one row per band and class, empty bank, policy and event
